0022600177.text: The Knicks, now 3-4 and 8th in the East, host the 1-6 Chicago Bulls, who have lost five straight and sit 13th in the East. New York is 2-2 at home this season, while Chicago has yet to win at home, going 0-2 there. The Knicks lead the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after a 133-127 win in Chicago on 2026-10-28, and they won the 2025-26 series 3-1. Bulls center Nic Claxton is out with a hamstring injury.
